newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key 182nd JGB yield rises 0.1 pct point.
newsitem.headline: Key 182nd JGB yield rises 0.1 pct point.

text.p: The benchmark 182nd Japanese government bond yield rose by 0.1 percentage point from the previous day's close to 2.680 percent in afternoon trade on Tuesday.
Traders said JGBs extended losses in afternoon trade after falling sharply in the morning, due to expectations that the results of the day's four-year JGB auction would be poor.

The removal of Nomura Securities from the JGB underwriting syndicate, and concerns that major brokerage houses would be reluctant to bid aggressively having struggled to sell JGBs to investors after the previous 10-year JGB auction, fuelled such speculation, traders said.
